title: Patmos: Historical Island & Visionary Threshold
subtitle: The certain island, unknown first-century spot, and later cave tradition
summary: Explore the securely identified island of Patmos while keeping John’s exact location unknown, the Cave of the Apocalypse traditional, and Revelation’s visionary worlds outside terrestrial mapping.
disclaimer: Patmos is securely identified as the island named in Revelation 1:9. Revelation does not specify a cave or exact point on the island. The traditional Cave of the Apocalypse is shown only as later reception history, and visionary entities continue to use the separate non-terrestrial Revelation system.
